summary.text: Patricia Canzoneri-Fitzpatrick is a Republican state senator from New York who has represented District 9 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on the Republican and Conservative Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is an attorney and certified public accountant.

paragraphs.text: Patricia Canzoneri-Fitzpatrick was born in Rockville Centre, New York.

She earned a bachelor's degree from St. John's University College of Business Administration in 1987 and a J.D. from St. John's University School of Law in 1994, and she also attended New York University School of Law.
Ballotpedia lists her professional experience as an attorney and a certified public accountant.
Canzoneri-Fitzpatrick assumed office in the State Senate on January 1, 2023, succeeding Todd Kaminsky.
Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments as Judiciary, Environmental Conservation, and ranking member of the Mental Health and Consumer Protection committees.
In the 2026 general election she faces Democrat Lisa Vider.
